text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright! You did it, you went the distance!
A full 3,600 meters, and in such incredible fashion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A passing grade... no, far beyond that.
Even to my eyes, that was a flawless run...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a stayer...? 
Grandmother, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has awakened.
Yes, Mejiro Bright... that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: I can run "anywhere." Any race, as long as it's between medium and long distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: G-Grandmother... G-Good day to you...

After the race, Mejiro Bright's expression stiffened
at the sight of an unexpected visitor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um~... thank you very much
for watching today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Have I finally become able
to contribute a little...?
Even someone like me, who was never expected to...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: —Who said that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wait, who did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Who told you that?
That no one has any expectations of you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
As long as one is born into Mejiro—
there is no umamusume from whom nothing is expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
All the more so if they wish to shine.
Every single one of us possesses a special power
capable of supporting the Mejiro family's future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A special... power...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. I told you, did I not?
'Keep a close eye on everyone.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I wasn't able to
run very skillfully, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is why I obediently followed your instructions
and merely observed. Exactly as you said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: I didn't tell you to "watch closely" because I'm incapable of running well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Your natural disposition. With that vast potential
and your generous heart—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could take it all in.
Every single ounce of talent and history belonging to the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Talent... and history...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And just as you saw, as your heart led,
you learned, grew, and began to radiate brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
So she can race medium distances like Ryan,
and run long distances like McQueen. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"The history of the Mejiro family resides within
your body. Past successes and failures alike
have all become the blood in your veins..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why, with those memories as a foundation,
there's a chance to seize all the glory that the Mejiro family's progenitor never could."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Every glory...
What my great-great-grandfather could not accomplish...
I shall...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because you are—
the very embodiment of Mejiro tradition itself.

As her profound foresight was revealed... the room fell dead silent.
This is—the Grand Design of the Mejiro family.
To think they saw Mejiro Bright's potential before it even sprouted, paving the path to her culmination...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Whether you wish it or not, you are the splendid
guiding star of the Mejiro family, Bright."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Do what you must do... carry it out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Grandmother...
Grandmotheeer... I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I am honored. I promise you that I shall
stride boldly forward to live up to those expectations.

The mystery is solved. Mejiro Bright is an Umamusume
with the talent to excel across a wide range of middle to long distances. And—

She had been raised through rigorous elite training behind the scenes,
etching the running styles of all the great Mejiro Umamusume into her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, I'm so glad... I'm so glad for you...
Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No wonder I thought something was amiss.
There is simply no way she could have adapted
to long distances that quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bright, within you...
our joys and our regrets live on, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Ryan-onesama, McQueen-sama.
I haven't forgotten a single thing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The many races of everyone I admire...
I shall stride forward while cherishing those memories.
For the sake of Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I leave it in your hands. Her potential may be immense, but you are the only one who can make Bright "ready in time."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you.
As a friend of the Mejiros.
And so, under the grand ambition of the Mejiro family's matriarch, the next door was opened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, next is of course...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), right? The race the Mejiro family values above all else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that lies the goal of claiming both the Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho.
Truly, the path to glory for the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I shall see this path
through to the very end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Across this glittering galaxy that my great-great-grandfather could not finish traversing. Straight ahead, like a shooting star.
